FROM (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS questions, 0 AS answers
  FROM posts_questions
  WHERE creation_date >= date('2022-09-25', '-1 month')
  GROUP BY user_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_id, 0 AS questions, COUNT(*) AS answers
  FROM posts_answers
  WHERE creation_date >= date('2022-09-25', '-1 month')
  GROUP BY user_id
) c
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_contributions DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_without_accepted_answer, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 3) AS no_accepted_rate FROM post_tags pt JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY no_accepted_rate DESC, question_count DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT q.post_id, q.title, q.creation_date, q.score, v.upvotes, v.downvotes, ROUND((v.upvotes + v.downvotes) * 1.0 * MIN(v.upvotes, v.downvotes) / MAX(v.upvotes, v.downvotes), 2) AS controversy_score
FROM (
  SELECT post_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes,
         SUM(CASE WHEN vote_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes
  FROM votes
  WHERE vote_type IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY post_id
  HAVING upvotes > 0 AND downvotes > 0
) v
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = v.post_id
ORDER BY controversy_score DESC;

  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_answers
  FROM posts_answers
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
) a
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
ORDER BY avg_answers_per_week DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         date(creation_date, '-6 days', 'weekday 1') AS week_start,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM posts_answers
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id, week_start
),
agg AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_answers,
         COUNT(*) AS active_weeks
  FROM weekly
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING SUM(cnt) >= 50
)
SELECT u.user_id,
       u.display_name,
       a.total_answers,
       a.active_weeks,
       ROUND(1.0 * a.total_answers / a.active_weeks, 3) AS avg_answers_per_active_week
FROM agg a
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id
ORDER BY avg_answers_per_active_week DESC
LIMIT 5;

FROM (
  SELECT user_id,
         COUNT(*) AS total_answers,
         SUM(is_accepted) AS accepted_answers,
         SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', datetime(creation_date, '-5 hours')) AS INTEGER) >= 22
                    OR CAST(strftime('%H', datetime(creation_date, '-5 hours')) AS INTEGER) < 5
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS night_answers
  FROM posts_answers
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
) s
WHERE accepted_answers >= 50
  AND 2 * night_answers > total_answers;

SELECT q.post_id, q.title, MIN(a.creation_date) AS first_answer_date, MAX(a.creation_date) AS last_answer_date, ROUND(julianday(MAX(a.creation_date)) - julianday(MIN(a.creation_date)), 2) AS range_days, COUNT(*) AS answer_count
FROM posts_answers a
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = a.parent_id
GROUP BY q.post_id, q.title
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY range_days DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT q.post_id, q.title, q.creation_date AS question_date, fa.first_answer_date, ROUND(julianday(fa.first_answer_date) - julianday(q.creation_date), 2) AS days_waited
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN (SELECT parent_id, MIN(creation_date) AS first_answer_date FROM posts_answers GROUP BY parent_id) fa ON fa.parent_id = q.post_id
ORDER BY julianday(fa.first_answer_date) - julianday(q.creation_date) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH tag_stats AS (
  SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_name,
         COUNT(*) AS question_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count,
         ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS accepted_share
  FROM post_tags pt
  JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
  JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
  GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'highest' AS category, tag_name, question_count, accepted_count, accepted_share
  FROM tag_stats

)
